{{Top|leg}}
The '''Threat Evaluation Module''' was part of the standard equipment installed on [[Criminal Location Detection Droid]]s. It allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to run through a series of threat analysis programs to determine the best response when locating a target.
